title: Desk Reference: Charges Within the Reach of the Patient Hardship Discount Program
content:
**Patient Hardship Discount Program — which charges a determination reaches, by level.** Patient Services Center reference card.

| Level | Earlier service dates covered, calendar days before the application date | Copays | Self-Pay Visit Package prices | Medicare patients | Charges already in a Patient Payment Plan | Only the patient's responsibility after insurance | Time-of-service deductible estimate before the payer adjudicates | Visits during the eligibility period, as charges post | Dependents in the applicant's tax household | Balances already with the collection agency recalled and discounted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hardship Discount Level 1 (25%) | 240 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Hardship Discount Level 2 (50%) | 240 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Hardship Discount Level 3 (75%) | 240 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Hardship Discount Level 4 (100%) | 240 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship | 240 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Presumptive Eligibility Discount | 240 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

**What each column answers**

- *Earlier service dates covered* — the number of calendar days before the application date back to which earlier service dates are covered.
- *Copays* — whether copays are discounted.
- *Self-Pay Visit Package prices* — whether Self-Pay Visit Package prices are discounted.
- *Medicare patients* — whether patients with Medicare coverage may receive the discount on an individual hardship determination.
- *Charges already in a Patient Payment Plan* — whether charges already enrolled in a Patient Payment Plan are discounted.
- *Only after insurance* — whether the discount applies only to the patient's responsibility after insurance.
- *Deductible estimate* — whether a time-of-service deductible estimate is discounted before the payer adjudicates the visit.
- *Visits during the eligibility period* — whether charges for visits during the eligibility period are discounted as they post.
- *Dependents* — whether the determination covers the charges of dependents in the applicant's tax household.
- *Collection agency* — whether balances already with the collection agency are recalled and discounted.

**Where the levels differ.** Every column reads the same at all six levels except the last: balances already with the collection agency are recalled and discounted at Hardship Discount Level 3 (75%), Level 4 (100%), Catastrophic Medical Hardship and the Presumptive Eligibility Discount, and not at Hardship Discount Level 1 (25%) or Level 2 (50%).

**Same at every level.** Copays: discounted. Self-Pay Visit Package prices: not discounted. Time-of-service deductible estimates: not discounted before the payer adjudicates. Dependents in the tax household: covered. Earlier service dates: covered back to 240 calendar days before the application date.
